explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares GPT-4o judgments with human evaluations on the same 50 sampled conversations from CraigslistBargain dataset, reporting agreement/disagreement percentages

prompts.notes: Appendix F.2 provides explicit prompts for overall quality evaluation on a 1-5 scale, with detailed criteria including helpfulness, appropriateness, target achievement, and coherency

guidelines.notes: Appendix H provides detailed evaluation guidelines for three criteria (persuasive, coherent, overall quality) and example conversations are provided in appendices

sample_size.notes: Random sample of 50 conversations from CraigslistBargain test set out of 188 total test cases

correlation_interpretation.threshold_used: Low disagreement percentage indicates strong alignment

validation_results.summary_finding: Both human evaluators and GPT-4o consistently rate DiffTOD as superior with low disagreement (12-20%), validating the reliability of the LLM-based dialogue evaluation protocol

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluation uses broader criteria including 'achievement' while human evaluation focuses on pairwise comparison of specific systems
